name: 圣光充能
description: 使己方所有棋子下次造成的伤害提高2点。
code: function executeCard(context) { const battle = context.battle; const playerId = context.playerId; const player = battle.players.find(function(p) { return p.playerId === playerId; }); if (!player) { return { success: false, message: '找不到玩家' }; } let buffAmount = 2; let buffMsg = ''; if (player.buffs && player.buffs['elune-blessing-buff'] && player.buffs['elune-blessing-buff'].uses > 0) { buffAmount = Math.floor(buffAmount * player.buffs['elune-blessing-buff'].multiplier); player.buffs['elune-blessing-buff'].uses--; buffMsg = '（月神赐福强化）'; } const allies = battle.pieces.filter(function(p) { return p.ownerPlayerId === playerId && p.currentHp > 0; }); allies.forEach(function(ally) { var buff = ally.statusTags && ally.statusTags.find(function(tag) { return tag.id === 'damage-buff' && tag.type === 'damage-buff'; }); if (buff) { var addedIndex = ally.statusTags.length; addStatusEffectById(ally.instanceId, { id: 'damage-buff', type: 'damage-buff', name: '强化', currentDuration: -1, currentUses: 1, intensity: buffAmount, stacks: 1, relatedRules: ['rule-damage-buff'] }); var added = ally.statusTags[addedIndex]; buff.intensity = (buff.intensity || 0) + (added.intensity || 0); ally.statusTags.splice(addedIndex, 1); buff.currentUses = 1; buff.remainingUses = 1; buff.stacks = 1; } else { addStatusEffectById(ally.instanceId, { id: 'damage-buff', type: 'damage-buff', name: '强化', currentDuration: -1, currentUses: 1, intensity: buffAmount, stacks: 1, relatedRules: ['rule-damage-buff'] }); } if (!ally.rules || !ally.rules.some(function(rule) { return rule.id === 'rule-damage-buff'; })) { addRuleById(ally.instanceId, 'rule-damage-buff'); } var activeBuff = ally.statusTags && ally.statusTags.find(function(tag) { return tag.id === 'damage-buff' && tag.type === 'damage-buff'; }); if (activeBuff) activeBuff.relatedRules = ['rule-damage-buff']; }); return { success: true, message: '圣光充能' + buffMsg + '：己方所有棋子下次伤害+' + buffAmount }; }
